title: Sincopante · los ecos en el motor
description: Sincopante's ecos in the effects lab over Las cuerdas' first fight, Gerard and Aitor against La Lealtad and her Eco (?fxlab, src/eco-fx.ts, src/eco-lab.ts; docs/animas/sincopante/README.md § Look and interface). Each moment is played on its own and caught as it happens: an Ostinato eco forming over the party, Bordón's halo, the beat, Crescendo dimming the fight round them, three ecos, all at f with their wings, the chord, an accent off the beat, Da capo, the ecos muffled, and Tutti. Only the look, never a fight's numbers. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Ostinato: the blow, a fine beam with two strands twisting round it, closes a halo on La Lealtad
Its eco settles over the party: one ring at p, its bell open towards the foes, a shaft of light to the floor
Bordón: a halo comes down over Gerard and its eco settles beside the first, rings lying flat, its light warmer

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.phase > .9) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: The beat: every eco lets a ring go, a halo closes on the foe, another falls over the ally, ripples run over the floor
Crescendo: the ecos swell to mf (two rings, motes rising) and the fight dims and greys round them for a moment
A third eco: three in the air, low, middle and high, a chord on a stave
All three at f: three rings each, wings of light at their sides, specks orbiting them

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.phase > .93) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: The beat at f with three ecos: the chord, lines of light joining them, beams to every foe, a halo on each ally, ripples across the whole side

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.offbeat) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: A contratiempo: pressed in the off-beat, every eco sounds again at once, accented in gold
Da capo: every ring turns backwards, a wave of nácar runs in over the party, the fight dims round the ecos
Muffled: their wearer is in another ánima; the ecos go on, under half their light, no gold, no motes
Tutti: the ecos gather over the foes into one great halo, the fight darkened and greyed round them, a column of warm light
Tutti lands: the halo closes on every foe, motes rise in the warm light
